text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Next,
let's organize support cards that will 
help you train your horsegirl!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Each card has its own effects,
such as the 
appearance of the characters in the
support 
card during training or giving you skills!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Please keep in mind you can't use 
support cards of the same horsegirl 
that you're training!
